objective: Test whether a representation optimized only on the admitted knowledge horizon ranks later formula families as more anomalous than held-out families from the admitted horizon.
claim_boundary: This is temporal formula-shape transfer and one-class model auditing, not causal attribution, discovery of a successor law, or a real-measurement benchmark.

phase_a.checkpoint_rule: epoch 30 fixed in advance; no selection on pre1950 or post1950 scores

architecture.structural_teacher: edge-aware AST message passing plus graph-local transformer attention
architecture.kan_use: one RBF-KAN-style local graph update; all other updates are MLP/SwiGLU
architecture.inference_query: unordered normalized x-y point cloud only

components: top-8 cosine distance to known graph-formula embeddings
top-8 cosine distance to known graph-identity centroids
top-8 cosine distance to empirical known point-formula prototypes
deterministic shrinkage Mahalanobis distance to empirical known point-formula prototypes
one_class_score.calibration: each component converted by its pre-cutoff calibration-formula empirical CDF
one_class_score.combination: unweighted arithmetic mean of the four calibrated component ranks
one_class_score.aggregation: median cloud score per formula, then median formula score per source-law family or frozen relation group
primary_comparisons: held-out pre1900 families versus generated 1901-1950 relation groups
held-out pre1900 families versus all 55 curated post1900 families
held-out known-horizon families/groups versus curated post1950 families
one_class_score.threshold_metrics: not primary; no q90/q95 result is required for the temporal ranking claim

phase_b_gate: Cumulative pre1950 training is forbidden until Phase A outputs are evaluated and hash-frozen.
paired_clock_test: For the same curated 1901-1950 families, compare calibrated anomaly ranks from the 1899 and 1950 checkpoints; report median paired collapse, bootstrap CI, and exact sign test.
